purpose: test whether task-specific Skill procedures explain the v11b Body-aware advantage
reuse_disclosure: This mechanism pilot deliberately reuses one v11b test variation per task family and is not an independent performance confirmation.

condition_definitions.body_aware_retrieval: retrieve Top-3 using the full v3 Skill body and load the complete selected Skills
condition_definitions.body_metadata_only: use the identical Body-aware Top-3 selection but load only Name, Description, and Activation Condition
condition_definitions.body_placebo: use the identical Body-aware Top-3 selection and metadata but replace Procedure and Termination Condition with task-irrelevant generic words matched to the original whitespace word count

decision_rule: The pilot checks implementation, prompt controls, and directional signal. It is not used for a confirmatory claim.
